title: High-Protein Peanut Chicken Noodle Bowl
reject_reason: Peanut-butter/soy/sriracha/lime sauced chicken with peppers, slaw and noodles is the same peanut-chicken identity as live slow-cooker-thai-peanut-chicken-bowls; noodles-vs-rice is not a distinguishing plate, the peanut-chicken region is saturated (5), and the near-identical peanut-butter-chicken was already ruled a dupe of this same live dish.
